name: Hakuji Laboratory
description: A quiet landing theme for a small dental laboratory that makes crowns and bridges for local practices. The home page opens on a collage: the headline, lead and a four-figure stats row beside a pair of photographs (42 and 58 percent, one large top-right radius) that cross-fade to a second pair, over a grey-violet slab with a three-line tagline. It continues with rounded white sheets lying over a parallax photo band, a shade-room sheet, a band of three title-over-photo case cards with dot links, four ruled upload steps, a full-width fee table, a ruled list of the people at the bench, a pick-up and hours band and a closing account sheet. Libre Baskerville and Literata with Noto Serif for Chinese and Japanese, a white ground and one grey-violet accent. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German. WCAG AA colours.
